name: Project Board
description: Source-linked proposals, resolutions, risks and explicit assignments.

sections.title: Matters Presented
sections.instruction: Record matters and proposals presented with source excerpts.

sections.title: Decisions and Resolutions
sections.instruction: Distinguish proposals, approvals, rejected items and conflicts. Never invent quorum, votes, resolutions or certainty.

sections.title: Risks and Unresolved Matters
sections.instruction: Retain risks, dissent and unresolved questions from available sources.

sections.title: Assignments
sections.instruction: Extract explicit named or office assignments only; do not resolve ambiguous pronouns or invent dates.
